returns.price: - feed value as returned by API3 (no extra scaling)

getPrice(uint256,address).notice: Get price snapshot for a token in a given epoch.

setApi3Proxy(address,address).notice: Configure the API3 reader proxy for a given token.

setPrice(address,uint256).notice: Manually set price for the current epoch (useful for testing or tokens without API3 feed).

updateFromApi3(address).notice: Pull current price from API3 and store a snapshot in the current epoch.

userdoc.notice: Stores per-epoch price snapshots for tokens.         Prices can come from API3 data feed proxies, or be set manually.         SettlementManager relies on:           - currentEpoch()  (via public state var)           - getPrice(epochId, token) -> (price, timestamp)
